scope_basis: Besides the telehealth application, the grant pays for a mobile clinic, health facility equipment, midwife training and awareness campaigns.
title: Government of Japan / UNFPA — Guinea maternal and neonatal telehealth digitisation (SPAQ), 2026
description: "Ce projet est financé par le gouvernement japonais à hauteur de 393 333 dollars américains." The project, titled "Amélioration de l'accès aux services de santé maternelle et néonatale et lutte contre les violences sexistes grâce à la numérisation d'un système intégré de diagnostic et de traitement optimisé pour les soins de santé à distance en Guinée," deploys SOIK Corporation's SPAQ technology — an application connected to a portable ultrasound scanner that centralises antenatal-follow-up results and enables monitoring in isolated areas — together with a mobile clinic, the equipping of ten health structures, and the training of twenty midwives, plus gender-based-violence awareness campaigns. Japanese ambassador Kato Ryuichi: "Notre soutien, d'un montant de 393 333 dollars américains, permettra de déployer une clinique mobile et d'équiper dix structures de santé."

scope_basis: Computer and solar kits bought to run commune accounting software.
title: AFD (C2D/PANAFIC) — ANAFIC local-government digitalisation hardware, 2025
description: ANAFIC's published result of national open tender AON N°001/PANAFIC/E/AFD/2025, under the PANAFIC project (Projet d'Appui à l'Agence Nationale de Financement des Collectivités Locales), financed by AFD's C2D debt-conversion facility (CGN 1263 01 R): Lot 1, computer kits for 21 local authorities (the 14 Conakry communes plus the Gouvernorat and 7 communes of the interior) awarded to BONIFE MULTI SERVICES at GNF 836,500,000; Lot 2, solar kits for 7 new rural communes of the interior awarded to FAMARY Industrie SARL at GNF 781,060,000. Both lots are explicitly procured "pour l'utilisation du logiciel de gestion comptable et financier" — the hardware and off-grid power that put the commune accounting/financial-management software into service. Signed in Conakry, 1 October 2025.

scope_basis: Urban surveillance system: cameras, command centres and security management platforms.
title: Guinea Safe City Urban Surveillance and Security Project
description: Concessional loan for deployment of urban surveillance and security management system across 324 sites in 8 Guinean cities, including CCTV cameras, command centers, and urban security management platforms.
recipient_organisation: Government of Guinea / Ministry of Plan and International Cooperation

scope_basis: Guarantee covering an equity investment in a mobile money subsidiary.
title: Orange Finances Mobiles Guinee SA – Mobile Money Guarantee (Sonatel equity)
description: MIGA guarantee covering Sonatel SA (Senegal) equity investment and retained earnings in Orange Finances Mobiles Guinee SA, the mobile money subsidiary in Guinea. Part of the combined Orange Guinea and Guinea Bissau guarantee (EUR 433.7M total). This tranche (PID 15192) covers $26.5M for the mobile money operations. Risks: Expropriation, War and Civil Disturbance, Transfer Restrictions & Currency Inconvertibility. Issued August 2023 (FY2024).

scope_basis: Guarantee on equity in a telecoms operator.
title: Orange Guinea – Telecoms Operator Guarantee (Sonatel equity)
description: MIGA guarantee of EUR 366.33 million (~$399.7M USD at Dec 2023 rates) issued December 18, 2023, to Sonatel SA (Senegal) covering its equity investments and retained earnings in Orange Guinee SA (telecom subsidiary in Guinea) and Orange Finances Mobiles Guinee SA (mobile money subsidiary). Covers risks of Expropriation, War and Civil Disturbance, and Transfer Restrictions & Currency Inconvertibility for 6 years. Supported by IDA PSW shared first-loss facility. This row covers the Orange Guinee SA (telecoms) component (PID 14395, $373.2M USD).

scope_basis: Health programme; national health information systems and DHIS2 are components of it.
title: Notre Santé - Guinea (Digital Health)
description: USAID Guinea Notre Santé health program with significant digital health components supporting national health information systems, DHIS2 implementation, and health data governance.

scope_basis: Credit is Guinea's share of a regional programme for broadband access and a single digital market.
title: World Bank — WARDIP SOP1, Guinea, 2023
description: Guinea's national allocation under the Digital Transformation for Africa / Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program (DTfA/WARDIP) Series of Projects 1 (PAD4756, Operation ID P176932, 7 November 2023): "IN THE AMOUNT OF US$60.0 MILLION TO THE REPUBLIC OF GUINEA" as an IDA credit. The SOP raises broadband access and usage and advances the West African single digital market. Implementing agency: Ministère de la Poste, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique (MPTEN).
